tagline.description: A few words saying who or what this concept is for, shown under the preview image (e.g. "Warm all-purpose Christmas card").

product_format.description: Format family of the product; it decides the allowed page_count range listed in the instructions.

page_count.description: Number of distinct designed printable pages/panels that each need their own artwork. Not the number of files or deliverable components: a folded greeting card (front, inside, back) is 3.

orientation.description: Orientation of the main design; the concept preview and the later canvas use it.

deliverable_components.description: Everything the customer receives, e.g. front design, inside message, back design, printing and folding guide. A component may share a page with others or need no artwork.

visual_route.description: This concept's OWN visual content as SHORT descriptors (noun phrases, not sentences, no rationale). The three concepts must differ strongly here; the shared creative direction only sets the style.

primary_subject.description: Short descriptor, not a sentence. Noun phrase naming the subject only, main noun last, e.g. "Red fox".

scene.description: Short descriptor, not a sentence. e.g. "Snow-covered pine woodland".

focal_object.description: Short descriptor, not a sentence. Noun phrase, main noun last, e.g. "Small wrapped Christmas parcel".

composition.description: Short descriptor, not a sentence. e.g. "Subject crossing lower third, open greeting space above".

lighting.description: Short descriptor, not a sentence. e.g. "Soft overcast winter daylight".

palette_emphasis.description: Short descriptor, not a sentence. e.g. "Ivory, pine green, muted red and icy blue".

emotional_tone.description: Short descriptor, not a sentence. e.g. "Warm, nostalgic and peaceful".

typography_approach.description: Short descriptor, not a sentence. e.g. "Elegant serif greeting centred in upper third".

distinguishing_visual_hook.description: Short descriptor, not a sentence. e.g. "Fox delivering a tiny Christmas parcel".

preview_brief.description: The single key image for this concept (a card front, or one representative page): subject, scene, composition, focal placement, typography placement and mood. It must differ clearly from the other two concepts.
